canada.summary: To be eligible for legal aid, an individual can't make more than $27,000 per year. A private family lawyer can cost someone hundreds of dollars per hour. Compounding the problem could be the territory’s lawyer shortage, which is hitting family law particularly hard.

New Orleans port sues to get control of tanker that crashed into cruise ship on Mississippi River, The Canadian Press reports.
SpaceX’s Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier, The Associated Press reports.

Airlines canceled thousands of flights across the U.S. on Saturday as they worked to recover from a nationwide ground stop a day earlier that left passengers scrambling for seats and disrupted travel around the world, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.

bds.h: SpaceX’s Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first
bds.lede: SpaceX’s Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier.
rows: SpaceX officials say catch by mechanical arms shows Starship's full reusability, crucial for rapid, low-cost recycling.
It was the first recovery of a Starship from orbit, a major milestone for a rocket SpaceX founder Elon Musk says will dramatically lower launch costs.
SpaceX’s Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier.

SpaceX's Starship spacecraft on Saturday returned from its longest flight in orbit yet to the Texas launch tower it was launched from a day prior, demonstrating the first key recovery of the rocket system's centerpiece vessel in the company's decade-long effort to ‌develop a fully reusable rocket.
Although booster exploded, company caught upper stage for first time in campaign to make megarocket reusable
The rocket stage was caught mid air using huge mechanical arms nicknamed “chopsticks”.
